Blocks for what no other block does: calling an existing bundle, or writing CFEngine policy yourself. [Custom CFEngine and Call Method][] explains when and how to use them.

## Call Method

Calls a bundle outside this canvas: stdlib, a module, or hand-written CFEngine.

**Generates:** a `methods` promise.

### Settings

| Setting         | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Bundle name** | Yes      | A bundle that already exists elsewhere — CFEngine's standard library, a cfbs module, or one you wrote by hand — e.g. "my_bundle" (looked up in the default namespace) or "ns:my_bundle". Canvas blocks call each other automatically; this isn't for that. |
| **Arguments**   | No       | One per line, in the bundle's parameter order. $(…) passes a variable's value, @(…) a list.                                                                                                                                                                |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Run site checks
methods:
  "Run site checks" usebundle => default:site_checks;
```

## Custom CFEngine

Hand-written CFEngine promises, for what no block covers.

**Generates:** the promises and definitions you write.

### Settings

| Setting                        | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Promises**                   | Yes      | Promise sections as in a bundle agent, e.g. files: then its promises. They run as a bundle of their own, in this file's namespace: write the standard library's bodies and bundles as default:name. |
| **Bodies and bundles it uses** | No       | Any body or bundle the promises call that isn't in the standard library, e.g. body copy_from mirror(from) { … }.                                                                                    |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Mirror the site
methods:
  "Mirror the site" usebundle => mirror_the_site;

# Custom CFEngine "Mirror the site", run as one step of main.
bundle agent mirror_the_site
{
  files:
    "/var/www/site"
      copy_from => mirror("/srv/site"),
      depth_search => default:recurse("inf");
}

# Bodies and bundles of Custom CFEngine "Mirror the site".
body copy_from mirror(from)
{
  source => "$(from)";
  purge => "true";
}
```
